n780576b316.headline: Rashi Peripherals raises Rs 150 crore in pre-IPO round
n780576b316.summary: Mumbai-based Rashi Peripherals raised Rs 150 crore in a pre-IPO round. The company is a national distributor of ICT products for brands including ASUS, Dell, HP and Lenovo.
n780576b316.why: Pre-IPO rounds are private capital raises ahead of a public listing, and Indian ICT distributors are sensitive to PC and electronics demand.

n49f3176522.headline: Shipping chiefs told UK ‘won’t stand by’ while Red Sea attacks continue
n49f3176522.summary: UK government officials told shipping industry leaders the country will not stand by while Red Sea attacks continue. Iran-backed Houthi rebels have continued to target shipping on the route.
n49f3176522.why: The Red Sea is a key trade route, and attacks on shipping raise freight costs and insurance premiums for global trade.

n876bb2bfcc.headline: Macra lobbys parliament for 2 year tax break in smartphones as only 1m Malawians have access to internet | Nyasa Times
n876bb2bfcc.summary: Malawi's communications regulator Macra is lobbying Parliament for a two-year tax break on smartphones. The move aims to widen internet access, as only about 1 million Malawians are online.
n876bb2bfcc.why: Import taxes on devices affect smartphone affordability and the growth of digital services and telecom markets.

source.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

sources.name: Malawi News | Breaking News, Politics, Business & Sports | Nyasa Times

n1b8a01965e.headline: Christmas was quiet for British shops, new data suggests
n1b8a01965e.summary: Retail sales volumes fell by 3.2% in December, according to Office for National Statistics data. Shoppers were quiet over the Christmas period, the data suggests.
n1b8a01965e.why: Retail sales are a key indicator of consumer spending, which makes up most of UK economic activity and shapes Bank of England policy expectations.

n887a0f2157.headline: 4,000 families to receive houses in the Northern Cape
n887a0f2157.summary: Government plans to build more than 4,000 houses across Northern Cape municipalities over 12 to 18 months. The programme is valued at R1 billion.
n887a0f2157.why: State housing programmes are public spending that supports construction activity and local contractors in South Africa.

n97a11a5d3f.headline: Orbán: Hungarian economy crisis-proof without EU funds
n97a11a5d3f.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán said the economy is crisis-proof even without European Union funding and can come through the hardest periods.
n97a11a5d3f.why: EU funding is a significant source of public investment in Hungary, so the country's reliance on it affects its fiscal outlook and investor sentiment.

nf2fcacfc12.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street hits record high following a 2-year round trip scarred by inflation
nf2fcacfc12.summary: Wall Street returned to record heights, capping a two-year round trip marked by high inflation and worries about a possible recession.
nf2fcacfc12.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equity performance. Its level reflects expectations for corporate profits and the economy.

n28378b3044.headline: Hunt says low taxes are ‘direction of travel’ ahead of election-year Budget
n28378b3044.summary: Chancellor Jeremy Hunt said low-tax countries were 'more dynamic' and that low taxes are the direction of travel ahead of the election-year Budget.
n28378b3044.why: UK tax and fiscal policy set in the Budget influence government borrowing, gilt yields, and business investment decisions.

nb5c47c2d39.headline: Arix Bioscience eyes USD19 million return from Harpoon sale
nb5c47c2d39.summary: London-based Arix Bioscience expects net proceeds of USD18.6 million from the USD680 million sale of Harpoon Therapeutics, a biotech company in its portfolio.
nb5c47c2d39.why: Arix Bioscience is a venture investor in biotechnology, so exits such as trade sales of portfolio companies drive its returns.

ne6e7468084.headline: Stock market today: Asian stocks track Wall Street gains and Japan’s inflation slows
ne6e7468084.summary: Asian markets were mostly advancing after Wall Street recouped most of the week's losses. Japan reported slowing inflation, which may keep its ultra-low interest rates steady.
ne6e7468084.why: Japan's inflation and Bank of Japan policy drive the yen and Japanese equities. Asian markets often follow Wall Street moves.

n77517aa23a.headline: Odu’a Investment Moves To List On NGX
n77517aa23a.summary: Odu'a Investment Company Ltd. has begun discussions with the Nigerian Exchange Ltd. to list and raise capital from investors.
n77517aa23a.why: A listing on the Nigerian Exchange gives companies access to local capital and gives investors a new equity to buy.

n652ab63945.headline: Davos sees nothing normal about the global economy for 2024
n652ab63945.summary: The final Davos panel of 2024 said the world economy is finding an uneasy equilibrium, with a more benign backdrop overshadowed by a range of geopolitical risks.
n652ab63945.why: The World Economic Forum's Davos annual meeting gathers global policymakers and business leaders, and its economic panels signal the outlook for growth and risk that investors watch.

nadf504cf7d.headline: Labour denies axing £28bn green investment pledge
nadf504cf7d.summary: Labour denied that it has axed its £28bn green investment pledge. The party's key pitch was not mentioned in a campaigning brief published earlier this week.
nadf504cf7d.why: The UK green investment pledge concerns public spending on energy and infrastructure, which affects the outlook for clean energy companies and fiscal plans. Policy commitments can shape investor expectations.

ne5ac8d740a.headline: Stock markets recover after 3 days of loss; ICICI, Airtel major gainers
ne5ac8d740a.summary: The BSE Sensex rebounded 496 points and the Nifty closed above 21,600 on Friday, cutting short three days of losses. Buying in heavyweight stocks and firm global markets supported the rebound.
ne5ac8d740a.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large Indian companies and is a key gauge of domestic equity sentiment. Its moves reflect shifts in foreign and domestic investor appetite for India.
ne5ac8d740a.why_moved: Buying in heavyweight stocks and a firm trend in global markets helped indices cut short three days of losses.

n3c3a34bc5f.headline: World Bank welcomes agreement on key parameters for Ghana –
n3c3a34bc5f.summary: The World Bank Group welcomed an agreement in principle on key parameters of Ghana's proposed debt restructuring. The deal was reached by the Official Creditors' Committee under the G20 Common Framework.
n3c3a34bc5f.why: Debt restructuring determines how much debt service a sovereign must pay, which affects its bond prices, currency and access to future financing.

na7dcd7c550.headline: NNPC discovers 83 illegal refineries, Abia prepares to launch new one
na7dcd7c550.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited announced fresh discoveries of illegal oil operations and refineries in the Niger Delta, while Abia prepares to launch a new one.
na7dcd7c550.why: Crude theft and illegal refining reduce Nigeria's legitimate oil output and revenue, which matters for the country's oil production and government finances.

n3f365e107d.headline: Japan inflation slows to 2.3 percent in December
n3f365e107d.summary: Japanese consumer inflation slowed again in December, due to lower electricity and gas bills, government data showed on Friday. The release came ahead of a Bank of Japan meeting.
n3f365e107d.why: Consumer inflation data shapes expectations for Bank of Japan policy, which affects Japanese bond yields, the yen and the equity market.

n30fe2f65df.headline: China leads global manufacturing sector for 14 consecutive years
n30fe2f65df.summary: China has remained the world's leading manufacturing hub for 14 consecutive years, according to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. The ministry announced the ranking on Friday.
n30fe2f65df.why: Manufacturing output and share of global production influence supply chains, commodity demand and the earnings outlook for industrial companies worldwide.

n35991592c9.headline: Why JD.com Stock Dropped 10% This Week
n35991592c9.summary: JD.com shares dropped about 10% during the week amid worrisome economic data and an analyst downgrade. The Chinese e-commerce company was hit by both factors.
n35991592c9.why: JD.com is one of China's largest e-commerce platforms, so its results and share price reflect consumer spending trends in China.

nbfebeec499.headline: Mazda Drops Mazda6 From Japanese Lineup
nbfebeec499.summary: Mazda will end production of the JDM-spec Mazda6 sedan and wagon in April 2024. The model was introduced to the Japanese market almost 22 years earlier.
nbfebeec499.why: Mazda is a Hiroshima-based automaker, and model discontinuations reflect changes in its product lineup and sales mix.

n20c74f29c7.summary: Users of Payoneer in Argentina lost up to $60,000 after attackers exploited the platform's SMS password reset feature.
